snippet.title: THE FORTRESS – Official GamePlay Trailer | Turn-Based Dark Fantasy Dungeon Crawler
snippet.description:
Step into The Fortress – a turn-based dark fantasy dungeon crawler where every decision carries weight.

Choose from 9 unique classes, roll the dice, and survive cursed rooms filled with enemies, traps, and bosses.
Loot, upgrade, and guide a prisoner on the run, aided by two mysterious women, in his quest to reach the tower’s peak and destroy the Lich—the master of the Fortress.

🎲 Tactics and risk come together in a dark, atmospheric world packed with secrets, characters, and high replayability.

🔓 Every run is different. Every choice matters.
Will you dare challenge the Fortress?

🎮​TRY THE DEMO ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3459150/The_Fortress/ 

📅 Release date: FALL 2025
